questions.question: Which sentence correctly uses inversion with the given condition?
options: Although it was raining, we decided to go out for a walk.
Not until the sun set did the party end.
Hardly had she finished her speech when the audience applauded.
So busy was she that she forgot to lock the door.
questions.answer: Hardly had she finished her speech when the audience applauded.

questions.question: Which cleft sentence correctly restates the following sentence: 'The most important factor in this decision was the team’s cohesion.'?
options: It was the team’s cohesion that the most important factor in this decision was.
The most important factor in this decision was that the team’s cohesion was critical.
What was most important in this decision was the team’s cohesion.
The decision was made because the team’s cohesion was the most important factor.
questions.answer: What was most important in this decision was the team’s cohesion.

questions.question: Which sentence correctly uses the subjunctive mood with a hypothetical condition?
options: If I were you, I would have taken that job.
If she had known the truth, she would have left immediately.
He wishes he could speak French fluently, but he doesn’t.
They suggest that we should have invited more guests.
questions.answer: If she had known the truth, she would have left immediately.

questions.question: Which sentence demonstrates correct ellipsis with a repeated phrase?
options: She said she would come, and she did come, but she was late.
He told me he would help, but he didn’t show up.
They argued that the plan was flawed, and they were right.
The meeting began late, and it ended early.
questions.answer: She said she would come, and she did come, but she was late.

questions.question: Which sentence uses a formal register and complex sentence structure to express nuanced meaning?
options: Although the evidence was inconclusive, the jury found him guilty.
He has been known to make mistakes, but he is generally reliable.
Given the circumstances, it is understandable that she was upset.
The report was so poorly written that it was rejected outright.
questions.answer: Although the evidence was inconclusive, the jury found him guilty.
